basic_info.description: Welcome to 309 Shields Street, a beautifully updated single-family home situated on a quiet street in the highly sought-after Merced Heights neighborhood. This inviting home features a functional open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout, offering a seamless blend of comfort and style. The living and dining area is perfect for entertaining, flowing directly into a modern, renovated kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances. Step outside to the spacious deck, and enjoy your morning coffee or unwind with an evening glass of wine while taking in picturesque mountain views.    The upper level is complete with two bedrooms and a full bathroom with a soaking tub. The versatile lower level boasts a large bonus room and a full bathroom, perfect for a third bedroom, in-law suite, or entertainment space. The beautifully landscaped backyard is designed for outdoor living, featuring multiple areas for relaxation and entertaining. A large garage with ample storage and washer and dryer complete this home. Ideally located just minutes to Brooks Park, Minnie & Lovie Ward Recreational Center, Ocean Avenue dining and shopping, Highway 280, and public transportation. Probate sale with no court confirmation. Agent - Please read private remarks for offer instructions
